entries.rationale: Accepted as a security-sensitive, env-gated huddle improvement, queued because it changes system-prompt inputs and model/runtime controls. The owner-signed huddle-guideline verification must remain fail-closed and all BUZZ_* controls must remain compatibility-only and bounded.
security_reasons: owner-signed huddle guidelines are promoted into the system prompt
channel tag and event signature are verified before accepting instructions
BUZZ_STT_* and BUZZ_TTS_* environment controls affect model/runtime behavior
streaming audio and cancellation paths require resource and privacy review

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated huddle prompt-injection and environment-control review, focused signature/streaming tests, dependency/egress screening, Zion compatibility checks, and desktop/Tauri gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, owner-signature/channel-binding tests, environment controls, changed voice/Tauri tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; automated security-access report not claimed because its advisory was interrupted; no source implementation made.
